sections.content: A useful prediction distinguishes facts, evidence, probability and uncertainty. Combine future forms, probability expressions, hypothetical conditions and connectors to explain what may happen and why.

items.spanish: Según la tendencia actual, los precios subirán el año que viene.
items.english: According to the current trend, prices will rise next year.

items.spanish: Sin embargo, quizá el resultado sea diferente si cambia la situación.
items.english: However, perhaps the outcome will be different if the situation changes.

items.spanish: Es posible que la tendencia continúe, aunque no podemos estar seguros.
items.english: It is possible that the trend will continue, although we cannot be sure.

items.spanish: Si apareciera un problema inesperado, probablemente tendríamos que cambiar el plan.
items.english: If an unexpected problem appeared, we would probably have to change the plan.

sections.content: A strong prediction explains both what you expect and how certain you are.
